```plato

    // The gradient of a planar SDF by central differences: one forward and one
    // backward evaluation per axis, which cancels the first-order error term.
    // Precondition: step is positive.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_difference)
    NumericGradientAt(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D, step: Number): Vector2D
        => Vector2D(
            self.Eval(Point2D(point.X + step, point.Y)) - self.Eval(Point2D(point.X - step, point.Y)),
            self.Eval(Point2D(point.X, point.Y + step)) - self.Eval(Point2D(point.X, point.Y - step)))
           / (2.0 * step);
```

    // The gradient of a spatial SDF by central differences.
    // Precondition: step is positive.
    NumericGradientAt(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D, step: Number): Vector3D
        => Vector3D(
            self.Eval(Point3D(point.X + step, point.Y, point.Z)) - self.Eval(Point3D(point.X - step, point.Y, point.Z)),
            self.Eval(Point3D(point.X, point.Y + step, point.Z)) - self.Eval(Point3D(point.X, point.Y - step, point.Z)),
            self.Eval(Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z + step)) - self.Eval(Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z - step)))
           / (2.0 * step);
